::: {#rem-data-set-subsets}

#### The sets we split a data set into

We divide a [data set](#def-data-set) into subsets, each with its own job.
"Set" in the names training set, validation set and test set is short for "subset of the data set".
A [training/validation/test split](#def-data-splits) assigns each observation to one of them,
and the [training set](#def-training-set) is the subset a fitting procedure is applied to.

:::
